entries.source_text:
SACK PACK, 765 NOTES
THIS BANJO ONLY MOVE HELPS PREVENT HIM GETTING INJURED BY THINGS ON THE GROUND. HOLD [0x88] OR [0x81] AND UP ON THE RIGHT STICK.
entries.translation:
MOCHILA PEQUENA, 765 NOTAS
ESTE MOVIMENTO EXCLUSIVO DO BANJO AJUDA A EVITAR QUE ELE SE MACHUQUE COM OBJETOS NO CHÃO. SEGURE [0x88] OU [0x81] E EMPURRE O STICK DIREITO PARA CIMA.

entries.source_text:
MAYAN KICKBALL
QUARTER-FINAL: 
KICK THE BALLS INTO YOUR GOAL TO SCORE 2 POINTS. 

SEMI-FINAL: 
RED BALLS REDUCE YOUR SCORE BY ONE. TRY KICKING THEM IN YOUR OPPONENTS' GOALS! 

FINAL: 
KICK THE BOMBS AT YOUR OPPONENTS TO STUN THEM. THE PLAYER WITH THE MOST POINTS IN THEIR GOAL AT THE END OF THE TIMER WINS THE MATCH.

ORDNANCE STORAGE
DEFUSE THE DYNAMITE WITH THE BEAK BAYONET TO WIN!

DODGEMS CHALLENGE
BLUE TWINKLES ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN TWINKLES 2 POINTS AND RED TWINKLES ARE WORTH 1 POINT. HIGHEST SCORE WINS!

HOOP HURRY
JUMP THROUGH AS MANY HOOPS AS POSSIBLE TO SCORE BIG. BLUE HOOPS AWARD 3 POINTS, GREEN 2 POINTS AND A RED HOOP GIVES YOU 1 POINT.

BALLOON BURST
FLY AROUND THE ROOM AND SHOOT EGGS AT THE BALLOONS. BLUE BALLOONS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN BALLOONS ARE WORTH 2 POINTS AND RED BALLOONS ARE WORTH 1 POINT.

SAUCER OF PERIL RIDE
BLUE TARGETS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN TARGETS 2 POINTS AND RED TARGETS ARE WORTH 1 POINT.

MINI-SUB CHALLENGE
BLUE MINES ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN MINES 2 POINTS AND RED MINES ARE WORTH 1 POINT. SHOOT AS MANY MINES IN THE TIME LIMIT!

CHOMPA’S BELLY
BLUE GERMS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN GERMS 2 POINTS AND RED GERMS ARE WORTH 1 POINT.

COLOSSEUM KICKBALL
THE LEAST POINTS WINS THE GAME! SHOOT THE GOOD BALLS INTO YOUR OWN GOAL! YELLOW BALLS INCREASE, RED BALLS DECREASE YOUR SCORE. FLASHING BALLS DOUBLE THE SCORING EFFECT. BOMBS ARE STUNNING.

POT O’ GOLD
SHOOT AS MANY JIGGIES AS FAST AS YOU CAN!

TRASH CAN GERMS
DESTROY THE GERMS TO GET POINTS AS QUICK AS POSSIBLE. BLUE GERMS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN GERMS ARE 2 POINTS AND RED GERMS ARE 1 POINT.

ZUBBAS’ HIVE
SHOOT THE ZUBBAS THAT APPEAR FROM THE WALLS. BLUE ZUBBAS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN ZUBBAS ARE 2 POINTS AND RED ZUBBAS ARE 1 POINT.

TOWER OF TRAGEDY
BUZZ IN AND TEST YOUR KNOWLEDGE OF THE GAME!
entries.translation:
MAYAN KICKBALL
QUARTAS DE FINAL: 
CHUTE AS BOLAS NO SEU GOL PARA MARCAR 2 PONTOS. 

SEMIFINAL: 
AS BOLAS VERMELHAS REDUZEM SUA PONTUAÇÃO EM UM PONTO. TENTE CHUTÁ-LAS NOS GOLS DOS ADVERSÁRIOS! 

FINAL: 
CHUTE AS BOMBAS NOS ADVERSÁRIOS PARA ATORDOÁ-LOS. O JOGADOR COM MAIS PONTOS NO GOL AO FIM DO TEMPO VENCE A PARTIDA.

ORDNANCE STORAGE
DESARME A DINAMITE COM A BAIONETA DE BICO PARA VENCER!

DODGEMS CHALLENGE
TWINKLES AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, TWINKLES VERDES VALEM 2 PONTOS E TWINKLES VERMELHAS VALEM 1 PONTO. QUEM FIZER MAIS PONTOS VENCE!

HOOP HURRY
ATRAVESSE O MAIOR NÚMERO POSSÍVEL DE AROS PARA MARCAR MUITOS PONTOS. AROS AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, AROS VERDES VALEM 2 PONTOS E UM ARO VERMELHO VALE 1 PONTO.

BALLOON BURST
VOE PELA SALA E ATIRE OVOS NOS BALÕES. BALÕES AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, BALÕES VERDES VALEM 2 PONTOS E BALÕES VERMELHOS VALEM 1 PONTO.

SAUCER OF PERIL RIDE
ALVOS AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, ALVOS VERDES 2 PONTOS E ALVOS VERMELHOS VALEM 1 PONTO.

MINI-SUB CHALLENGE
MINAS AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, MINAS VERDES VALEM 2 PONTOS E MINAS VERMELHAS VALEM 1 PONTO. ATIRE NO MAIOR NÚMERO DE MINAS POSSÍVEL DENTRO DO TEMPO!

CHOMPA'S BELLY
GERMS AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, GERMS VERDES VALEM 2 PONTOS E GERMS VERMELHOS VALEM 1 PONTO.

COLOSSEUM KICKBALL
VENCE QUEM TIVER MENOS PONTOS! CHUTE AS BOLAS BOAS NO SEU PRÓPRIO GOL! AS BOLAS AMARELAS AUMENTAM SUA PONTUAÇÃO; AS VERMELHAS A DIMINUEM. BOLAS PISCANTES DUPLICAM O EFEITO NA PONTUAÇÃO. BOMBAS ATORDOAM.

POT O' GOLD
ATIRE NO MAIOR NÚMERO POSSÍVEL DE JIGGIES O MAIS RÁPIDO QUE PUDER!

TRASH CAN GERMS
DESTRUA OS GERMS O MAIS RÁPIDO POSSÍVEL PARA MARCAR PONTOS. GERMS AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, GERMS VERDES VALEM 2 PONTOS E GERMS VERMELHOS 1 PONTO.

ZUBBAS' HIVE
ATIRE NOS ZUBBAS QUE SURGIREM DAS PAREDES. ZUBBAS AZUIS VALEM 3 PONTOS, ZUBBAS VERDES 2 PONTOS E ZUBBAS VERMELHOS 1 PONTO.

TOWER OF TRAGEDY
APERTE O BOTÃO E TESTE SEUS CONHECIMENTOS SOBRE O JOGO!

PLAYER WITH THE MOST POINTS WINS AND REMEMBER GRENADE, CLOCKWORK AND PROXIMITY EGGS DO THE MOST DAMAGE!

BLUE TWINKLES ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN TWINKLES 2 POINTS AND RED TWINKLES ARE WORTH 1 POINT. HIGHEST SCORE WINS!

HOOP HURRY CHALLENGE
JUMP THROUGH AS MANY HOOPS AS POSSIBLE TO SCORE BIG. BLUE HOOPS AWARD 3 POINTS, GREEN 2 POINTS AND A RED HOOP GIVES YOU 1 POINT.

BALLOON BURST CHALLENGE
FLY AROUND THE ROOM AND SHOOT EGGS AT THE BALLOONS. BLUE BALLOONS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN BALLOONS ARE WORTH 2 POINTS AND RED BALLOONS ARE WORTH 1 POINT.

MINI-SUB SHOOTOUT
GET CLOSE TO YOUR OPPONENT TO MAKE YOUR TORPEDOES HOME IN! HIGHEST SCORE WINS!

CHOMPA’S BELLY CHALLENGE
SHOOT DOWN AS MANY GERMS AS YOU CAN! BLUE GERMS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN GERMS 2 POINTS AND RED GERMS ARE WORTH 1 POINT.

PACKING ROOM CHALLENGE
BLUE ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN ARE WORTH 2 POINTS AND RED 1 POINT. SCORE AS MANY AS YOU CAN!

COLOSSEUM KICKBALL CHALLENGE
THE LEAST POINTS WINS THE GAME! KICK THE YELLOW BALLS INTO YOUR OPPONENTS GOAL AND THE RED BALLS INTO YOUR GOAL!

TRASH CAN CHALLENGE
DESTROY THE GERMS TO GET POINTS AS QUICK AS POSSIBLE. BLUE GERMS ARE WORTH 3 POINTS, GREEN GERMS ARE 2 POINTS AND RED GERMS ARE 1 POINT. THE PLAYER WITH THE HIGHEST SCORE WINS!

TOWER OF TRAGEDY QUIZ
BUZZ IN AND TEST YOUR KNOWLEDGE OF THE GAME!
